title: Online State-Representation Adaptation under Synthetic Interaction-Cue Remapping
abstract: arXiv:2611.23836v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When cues change what they predict, continuing to update a learned mapping may help an agent choose the appropriate action. We tested this in a one-step synthetic task by comparing a logistic state predictor that continued to learn from state labels with the same predictor frozen at transfer. We evaluated ten conditions in six held-out environments, with 1,296 paired runs per condition and 1,296,000 transfer records in total. Late action accuracy was 93.39% with online updates and 64.63% with frozen coefficients, a paired difference of 28.76 [8.73, 53.19] percentage points (95% environment-bootstrap interval). A direct policy reached 95.65% using the same predictions with a different action threshold. A contextual bandit reached 94.23% and earned more cumulative utility than the adaptive predictor. translated_title: 合成交互线索重映射下的在线状态表征自适应
translated_abstract: 当线索改变其所预测的内容时，持续更新已学习的映射可能有助于智能体选择恰当的动作。我们在一个单步合成任务中对此进行了验证，将一个持续从状态标签中学习的逻辑回归状态预测器与迁移时系数被冻结的同一预测器进行比较。我们在六个留出环境中评估了十种条件，每种条件进行1,296次配对运行，总计1,296,000条迁移记录。采用在线更新时后期动作准确率为93.39%，而冻结系数时仅为64.63%，配对差值为28.76 [8.73, 53.19] 个百分点（95%环境自助法置信区间）。使用相同预测但不同动作阈值的直接策略达到了95.65%。情境多臂老虎机达到了94.23%，并比自适应预测器获得了更高的累积效用。该老虎机利用了其所选动作的奖励，而在此任务中，奖励与所选动作相结合可以揭示真实状态。基于d的权重（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 在线索重映射的合成任务中，持续在线更新状态映射的预测器较冻结系数的预测器将后期动作准确率提升28.76个百分点，且情境老虎机通过利用可揭示真实状态的动作奖励获得了最高的累积效用。
en_tdlr: In a synthetic cue-remapping task, an adaptive logistic state predictor with online updates improves late action accuracy by 28.76 percentage points over a frozen predictor, while a contextual bandit leveraging action rewards that reveal the true state achieves the highest cumulative utility.
